Pinned p3-fri 0.6.1, copied from the source inventory used by the CPU baseline.

The bounded-cpu-openings feature adds an explicit, default-off constructor option. It fuses row compression into opening reduction, retires adjusted interpolation weights and coset values after their final use, and drops denominator vectors before FRI. Matrix/point order, alpha offsets, hiding, FRI parameters, verification and proof encoding are unchanged.

Upstream MIT OR Apache-2.0 licensing is preserved; the Apache-2.0 license text is included.
